description: The nth secant number, the signed Euler number E(2n) = (-1)^n * a(2n). E(0) is 1, E(2) is -1, E(4) is 5, and E(6) is -61. n runs from 0 to 20. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/euler-secant
